text: For the person who loves anything mini… How cute is this little purse?! You know how your earbuds always end up at the bottom of your bag? It clips right onto your handbag, and you can stash your earbuds, lip balm, keys, or other tiny essentials inside. The scarf and gold hardware make it look so much more expensive than a typical bag charm. AND it makes the cutest little stocking stuffer! Grab one for yourself and one for a friend who loves all things mini. It's linked in the orange cart!
